title: weezi
tagline: Now - simple CRM for DAO Asset Management in DeFi, NFT and GameFi. Tomorrow - disrupter of family offices, trusts, endowments, charity and grants organizations
description:
This is what we are building with weezi.io

Berezka DAO + BIA (Blockchain Industrial Alliance) have joined forces to create something fascinating. With Berezka DAO we have already launched and are managing a range of DAOs since mid-2019 with sustainably pleasant APY and ever growing AUM.

With BIA team we have already launched a template DAO Constructor that launches the mostly used DAO structure for any asset manager on Ethereum. Now within the framework of the ETHonline we will move our working DAO Constructor to Polygon and introduce very handy interfaces for asset managers:

Deploy your personal DAO in 1 click.
Create your unique DAO name, token names and tickers, voting rules - get a freshly baked DAO in a manner of minutes with one click (easier than opening an LLC in any country).
Allow your LPs (Limited Partners, or investors/contributors) to easily deposit/withdraw funds, tack performance over historical data indexed by Graph, see their actual real-time ROI in actual USD, allow "instant rage quit" to avoid DAO managers misconduct.
Handy interface for GPs (General Partners or DAO managers, who have voting rights) allowing to easily switch between DAOs; initiate voting, vote and keep track of all historical voting; initiate asset allocation/relocation via one interface.
*** Benefits and other cool features (at different stages of development):

⁃ Immediate and cheap rollout and management ⁃ Individual token names ⁃ Personalised front end ⁃ Automated analytics and charts on all activity and individual member performance (The Graph, Zerion) ⁃ Real-time calculation and traction of GPs’ ‘success fees’ ⁃ Real-time online verification of AUM on DAO’s wallets (Zerion, Debank) ⁃ Active management of whitelisted DeFi resources via voting (Snapshot) ⁃ Automated asset allocation strategies flexibly managed/changed via voting ⁃ Referral programs and interface ⁃ Optional integrated KYC module for LPs (Synaps) ⁃ Optional integrated fiat on/off ramp for LPs (Chatex) ⁃ Option to immediate listing of tokens on DEXes, lending protocols and info resources
